title: Cannot connect to different MCP servers

triage_metadata.reasoning: The issue reports that MCP servers fail to connect without displaying error messages, but the settings.json file and MCP server configuration details are provided only as image attachments. Critical details needed to reproduce and diagnose the issue—such as text-based settings.json configuration snippets (commands, arguments, and environment variables), specific MCP server details, and debug/verbose terminal logs—are missing.
triage_metadata.comment: Hi! Thanks for commenting on this issue, we need more information to triage the bug. Could you please provide: 1) The text version of your settings.json configuration containing the MCP server definitions (commands, args, env). 2) The specific MCP server(s) you are attempting to connect to. 3) Any CLI terminal output or debug logs when attempting to run and connect to the MCP servers.
